English: GTA-mediated gene transfer activity has been shown for few bacteria, with Rhodobacter capsulatus being the prototypical GTA.

Zulu: I-GTA ayizange ifundwe ngaphambili kuma-bacterium pathogenic plant.

English: A recent study inferring recombination in strains of the bacterial spot xanthomonads identified a Nigerian lineage which showed unusual recombination background.

English: We identified GTA clusters in other Xanthomonas species as well as species of Agrobacterium and Pantoea.
Luganda: Twazuula ebirimba bya GTA mu bika bya Xanthomonas ebirala ne mu bika Agrobacterium ne Pantoea.
Yoruba: A ṣàwárí àwọn ìṣùpọ̀ GTA nínú àwọn ọ̀wọ́ batéríà àti lára àwọn ẹ̀yà batéríà aṣàtakò-yíyọ-irúgbìn àti àwọn batéríà apa-irúgbìn.
Zulu: We identified GTA clusters in other Xanthomonas species as well as species of Agrobacterium and Pantoea.
Hausa: Mun gano gungu na GTA a cikin wasu jinsunan Xanthomonas da ma nau’in Agrobacterium da kuma Pantoea.
Northern Sotho: Re ile ra hlatha dihlopha tša GTA ka go mehuta ye mengwe ya Xanthomonas gammogo le mehuta ya Agrobacterium le Pantoea.
Amharic: በሌሎች የዛንቶሞናስ ዝርያዎች እንዲሁም በአግሮባክቴሪየም እና በፓንቶኢያ ዝርያዎች ውስጥ ጂ.አ.ወ ክለስተርን ለይተን አውጥተናል።

English: Recombination analyses showed that generally, strains of Xanthomonas with GTA have more inferred recombination events than strains without GTA, which could lead to genome divergence.
Luganda: Okwekenneenya okuwaanyisiganya kw’endagabutonde kwalaga nti okutwaliza awamu, ebika bya Xanthomonas ebirina GTA birina okuwaanyisiganya kw’endagabutonde okusinga ku bika ebitalina GTA, ekiyinza okuleetawo okwawukana kwa genome.
Yoruba: Ìtúpalẹ̀ aṣàtúnsopọ̀ fi hàn pé lápapọ̀, àwọn àwòmọ́ àwọn ọ̀wọ́ batéríà pẹ̀lú GTA ni ìrísí ìṣàsopọ̀ ju àwòmọ́ àwọn tí kò ní GTA lọ, èyí tí ó lè jásí ìyàtọ̀ ẹ̀yọ́ ìran.
Zulu: Ukuhlaziywa kokuhlanganiswa kabusha kwabonisa ukuthi ngokuvamile, izinhlobo ze-Xanthomonas ezine-GTA zinezehlakalo eziningi zokuhlanganisa kabusha kunezinhlobo ezingenayo i-GTA, ezingaholela ekwehlukaneni kofuzo.
Hausa: Nazarin sake haɗewa ya nuna cewa gabaɗaya, nau’o’in Xanthomonas tare da GTA suna da abubuwan sake haɗewa da yawa fiye da nau’o’i da ba tare da GTA ba, wanda zai iya haifar da rarrabuwar ƙwayar gado.
Northern Sotho: Tshekatsheko ya kopanyo ya dipaktheria e laeditše gore ka kakaretšo, go loma ga Xanthomonas ka go GTA go na le ditiragalo tša go kopanya go feta go loma ga go hloka GTA, gomme se se ka feletša ka gore ditšini di farologane.
Amharic: መልሶ የመቀላቀል ትንተና እንዳሳየው በጥቅሉ ጂ.አ.ወ ያላቸው የዛንቶሞናስ ስትሬኖች ጂ.አ.ወ ከሌላቸው ስትሬኖች በላይ በብዛት የተገመቱ የመልሶ መቀላቀል ክስተቶች አሏቸው፤ ይህም የጂኖም ልዩነትን ሊያመጣ ይችላል።

English: This study identified GTA clusters in species of the plant pathogen genera Xanthomonas, Agrobacterium and Pantoea which we have named XpGTA, AgGTA andPaGTA respectively.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwazuula ebirimba bya GTA mu bika by’obuwuka bw’ebimera ebya Xanthomonas, Agrobacterium ne Pantoea bye tutuumye XpGTA, AgGTA ne PaGTA mu busengeke obwo.
Yoruba: Ìwádìí yìí ṣàwárí àwọn ìṣùpọ̀ GTA nínú àwọn ẹ̀yà jíìnì ọ̀wọ́ batéríà afàrùn sára irúgbìn àti batéríà apa-irúgbìn èyí tí a ti dárúkọ XpGTA, AgGTA àti PaGTA ní ṣísẹ̀-n-tẹ̀lé.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luhlonze amaqoqo e-GTA ohlotsheni lwesitshalo se-pathogen i-Xanthomonas, i-Agrobacterium ne-Pantoea esiyiqambe ngokuthi i-XpGTA, i-AgGTA ne-PaGTA ngokulandelana.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya gano gungu na GTA a cikin jinsunan cututtukan shuka Xanthomonas, Agrobacterium da kuma Pantoea waɗanda muka raɗa wa suna XpGTA, AgGTA da kuma PaGTA bi-da-bi.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di hlathile sehlopha sa mehuta ya GTA ya diphedinyana tša go fetetša malwetši go dimela e lego Xanthomonas, Agrobacterium le Pantoea tšeo di bilego le XpGTA, AgGTA le PaGTA.

English: Researchers affiliated with Nigerian and United States universities said they identified “gene transfer agents” (GTAs) in bacteria that cause plant diseases.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza b’omu yunivaasite z’omu Nigeria ne Amerika baagamba nti baazuula “ebitambuza obulagabutonde”(GTAs) mu bakitiiriya ezireeta obulwadde bw’ebimera.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí tí wọ́n ń ṣiṣẹ́ ní àwọn fásitì Nàìjíríà àti United States sọ pé àwọn ṣe ìdámọ̀ “jíìnì aṣàkóso ìtànká” (GTAs) lára àwọn kòkòrò tí wọ́n ń ṣokùfà àìsàn fún irúgbìn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi abaxhumene namanyuvesi aseNigeria nase-United States bathi bahlonze “ama-gene transfer agents” (GTAs) kumabhaktheriya adala izifo zezitshalo.
Hausa: Masu bincike da suke da alaƙa da jami'o'in Nijeriya da kuma Amurka sun ce sun gano "wakilan sauya wurin ƙwayar gado" (GTAs) a cikin ƙwaar cutar da take haifar da cututtukan shuka.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši bao ba ingwadišitšego le diyunibesithi tša ka Nigeria le tša ka United States ba boletše gore ba hlathile “diphedinyana tša go fetetša ditšini” (di-GTA) ka go dipakthera tše di bakago malwetši a dimela.
Amharic: ከናይጄሪያ እና ከዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ዩንቨርሲቲዎች ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸው ተመራማሪዎች እንዳሉት ”የጂን አስተላላፊ ወኪሎችን” (ጂ.አ.ወችን) የአትክልት በሽታዎችን ከሚያስከትል ባክቴሪያ ለይተው እንዳወጡ ተናግረዋል።

English: These genetic elements help drive the evolution (genetic changes) of the bacteria over time, so understanding more about them may ultimately help scientists better manage the plant diseases they cause.
Luganda: Ebintu bino biyamba mu kuleetawo enkyukakyuka (enkyukakyuka z’endagabutonde) eza bakitiiriya ekiseera bwe kigenda kiyitawo, noolwekyo okwongera okubitegeera kiyinza okuyamba ku bannassaayansi okukwata obulungi endwadde z'ebimera ze bireeta.
Yoruba: Àwọn ohun ajẹmọ́jíìnì wọ̀nyí ń ṣèrànwọ́ fún àtiwáyé (àyípadà ajẹmọ́jíìnì) kòkòrò batéríà láti ìgbà dégbà, fún ìdí èyí, níní ìmọ̀ síi nípa wọn lè ṣe ìrànwọ́ fún àwọn onímọ̀ sáyẹ́ńsì láti ṣe ìtọ́jú àwọn àrùn tí wọ́n bá fà.
Zulu: Lezi zakhi zofuzo zisiza ekuqhubekiseni inguquko (izinguquko zofuzo) zamabhaktheriya ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngakho ukuqonda okwengeziwe ngawo kungase ekugcineni kusize ososayensi balawule kangcono izifo zezitshalo abazibangelayo.
Hausa: Waɗannan ƙwayoyin gado suna taimakawa wajen haifar da juyin halitta (sauye-sauyen ƙwayoyin gado) na ƙwayar cuta yau da gobe, domin haka, ƙara fahimtar su zai iya taimakawa masana kimiyya a ƙarshe domin kulawa da cututtukan shuka da suke haifarwa.
Northern Sotho: Dikarolo tše tša ditšini di thuša go baka go hlamega (diphetogo tša ditšini) ga ditšini ge nako e dutše e sepela, ka fao go kwešiša tše ntši ka ga tšona mafelelong go ka thuša bašomi ba tša mahlale go laola bokaone malwetši a dimela ao di a bakago.
Amharic: እነዚህ ጄኔቲካዊ ንጥረ ነገሮች በጊዜ ብዛት የባክቴሪያውን ዝግመታዊ (ጄኔቲካዊ ለውጦች) እድገት የሚነዱ ሲሆን፤ ስለዚህ ስለእነሱ የበለጠ መረዳት በዋነኝነት የሚያስከስቷቸውን የአትክልት በሽታዎች ሳይንቲስቶች በተሻለ መልኩ እንዲያስተዳድሩ ሊረዷቸው ይችላሉ።

English: Plant pathogenic bacteria are tiny microorganisms that cause disease in the plants they infect.
Luganda: Bakitiiriya ezireeta obulwadde bw’ebimera buba buwuka obutono ennyo obuleeta obulwadde mu bimera bye bukwata.
Yoruba: Àwọn batéríà afàìsàn irúgbìn jẹ́ ohun abẹ̀mí tí ò ṣeé fojú rí tí ó máa ń fa àìsàn sára àwọn irúgbìn tí wọ́n bá se àkóràn fún.
Zulu: Amagciwane ezitshalo angamagciwane amancane abangela izifo ezitshalweni azithelelayo.
Hausa: Ƙwayoyin cuta masu cutar da tsirrai wasu ƙananan ƙwayoyin halitta ne waɗanda suke haifar da cututtuka a cikin tsirran da suke harba.
Northern Sotho: Dipaktheria tša go baka malwetši dimeleng ke diphedinyana tše nnyane kudu tše di bakago malwetši go dimela tšeo di di fetetšago ka malwetši.
Amharic: የአትክልት የበሽታ አምጪ ባክቴሪያዎች ኢንፌክት በሚያደርጓቸው አትክልቶች ውስጥ በሽታን የሚያስከስቱ ጥቃቅን ረቂቅ ተህዋስያን ናቸው።

English: Like all living organisms, the instructions that determine the structure and function of these bacteria are coded for within their genes, and small changes in this genetic code is what allows it to adapt to new environments or challenges over time.
Luganda: Ng’ebiramu ebirala byonna, ebiragiro ebisalawo obuzimbe n’ebikolebwa bakitiiriya zino birambiddwa mu bulagabutonde bwazo, era enkyukakyuka entono mu bulambe bw’endagabutonde buno ze zibusobozesa okuwangaalira mu mbeera oba okusoomoozebwa okupya okumala ekiseera.
Yoruba: Gẹ́gẹ́ bí gbogbo àọn abẹ̀mí pátá, òfin tí ó ń pinnu ìhun àti ojúṣe àwọn kòkòrò batéríà yìí wà nínú àkóónú àwọn jíìnì wọn, àti àwọn àyípadà díẹ̀ tí ó wáyé nínú àwọn jíìnì wọn òun ni ó ń fún un láàyè láti lè gbé ní àwọn agbègbè tuntun àti láti kojú àwọn ìpèníjà tí ó bá dìde láti ìgbà dé ìgbà.
Zulu: Njengazo zonke izinto eziphilayo, imiyalelo enquma ukwakheka nokusebenza kwalawa mabhaktheriya anekhodi ngaphakathi kwezakhi zawo zofuzo, futhi izinguquko ezincane kule khodi yofuzo yizo ezivumela ukuthi ivumelane nezimo ezintsha noma izinselele ngokuhamba kwesikhathi.
Hausa: Kamar kowane rayayyun halittu, umarnin da yake ƙayyade tsari da aikin waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta an ƙididdige su a cikin ƙwayoyin gadonsu, kuma ƙananan sauye-sauye a cikin wannan tsarin ƙwayar gado shi ne abin da yake ba shi damar dacewa da sababbin yanayi ko ƙalubale yau da gobe.
Northern Sotho: Go swana le diphedinyana ka moka, ditaelo tšeo di laolago sebopego le go šoma ga dipaktheria tše di khoutilwe ka gare ga ditšini tša tšona, gomme diphetogo tše nnyane ka mo go dikhoutu tša ditšini ke seo se e dumelelago go tlwaelo seemo se seswa goba ditlhohlo ge nako e dutše e sepela.
Amharic: ልክ አንደ ህያው ፍጥረታት የእነዚህን ባክቴሪያዎች መዋቅር እና ተግባር የሚወስኑ መመሪያዎች በጂኖቻቸው ውስጥ ኮድ ተደርገዋል፤ እንዲሁም በጄኔቲክ ኮድ ውስጥ የሚከሰቱ አነስተኛ ለውጦች በጊዜ ብዛት ከአዲስ አካባቢዎች እና ተግዳሮቶች ጋር እንዲላመዱ ያደርጓቸዋል።

English: Some bacteria use “gene transfer agents” (GTAs) to introduce such genetic changes by transferring genetic material between one another (as opposed to transferring its genetic material to its offspring).
Luganda: Bakitiiriya ezimu zikozesa “ebitambuza obulagabutonde” (GTAs) okuleetawo enkyukakyuka ezo mu ndagabutonde okuyita mu kukyusa endagabutonde wakati waazo (so si okuwa abaana baazo endagabutonde).
Yoruba: Àwọn batéríà a máa lo “jíìnì aṣàkóso ìtànká” (GTA) láti ṣàfikún irú àwọn àyípadà ajẹmọ́jíìnì nípa títaari àwọn ohun-èlò ajẹmọ́jíìnì síra wọn (dípò títaari àwọn ohun-èlò ajẹmọ́jiìnì sí àwọn ọmọ rẹ̀).
Zulu: Amanye amagciwane asebenzisa “ama-ejenti okudluliselwa kofuzo” (GTAs) ukwethula izinguquko ezinjalo zofuzo ngokudlulisela izinto zofuzo phakathi kwelinye (ngokuphambene nokudlulisela ufuzo enzalweni yalo).
Hausa: Wasu ƙwayoyin cuta suna amfani da "wakilan sauya wurin ƙwayar gado" (GTAs) domin gabatar da irin waɗannan sauye-sauyen ƙwayoyin gado ta hanyar sauya wurin ƙwayoyin gadon a tsakanin juna (saɓanin sauya wurin ƙwayoyin gado zuwa ’ya’yansa).
Northern Sotho: Dipaktheria tše dingwe di šomiša “diphedinyana tša go fetiša ditšini” (di-GTA) go tliša diphetogo tša ditšini ka go fetiša ditšini magareng ga tšona (go fapana le go fetiša ditšini tša tšona go bana ba tšona).
Amharic: አንዳንድ ባክቴሪያዎች “የጂን አስተላላፊ ወኪሎችን” (ጂ.አ.ወችን) በመጠቀም አንደዚህ ያሉ ጄኔቲካዊ ለውጦችን ጄኔቲካዊ ቁሳቁሶችን እርስ በእርስ በመለዋወጥ ያስተዋውቃሉ (የጄኔቲክ ቁሳቁሱን ለልጅ ከማስተላለፍ በተጻረረ መልኩ ማለት ነው)።

English: Researchers had previously noticed a pattern of genetic changes similar to those caused by GTAs in a plant disease-causing Xanthomonas strain from Nigeria, and decided to investigate further.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza mu kusooka baazuula enkyukakyuka mu ndagabutonde ezifaanana n’ezo ezireetebwa GTAs mu bika bya Xanthomonas ebireeta endwadde mu bimera okuva mu Nigeria, ne basalawo okwongera okunoonyereza.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí ti ṣe àkíyèsí bátànì àyípadà ajẹmọ́jíìnì èyí tí ó fara pẹ́ èyí tí àwọn GTA máa ń fà nínú àwọn ọ̀wọ́ batéríà tí wọ́n lè fà àrùn láti ara irúgbìn ní Nàìjíríà, wọ́n sì pinnu láti túnbọ̀ tẹ̀síwájú nínú ìwádìí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bake babona iphethini yezinguquko zofuzo ezifana nalezo ezibangelwa ama-GTA ohlobo lwe-Xanthomonas olubangela isifo sezitshalo oluvela eNigeria, futhi banquma ukuphenya okwengeziwe.
Hausa: Masu bincike a baya sun lura da wani nau’i na sauye-sauyen ƙwayoyin gado irin wanda GTAs suke haifarwa a cikin wata cuta da take haifar da cutar Xanthomonas daga Nijeriya, kuma sun yanke shawarar ƙara bincikawa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši mo nakong ye e fetilego ba lemogile mokgwa wa diphetogo tša ditšini wa go swana le wo o bakwago ke di-GTA ka go bolwetš bja dimela bjo bo bakago phetetšo ka Xanthomonas go tšwa ka Nigeria, gomme ba tšea sephetho sa go nyakišiša go tšwela pele.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች ከናይጄሪያ ስትሬኖች የአትክልት በሽታን ከሚያስከስቱ ዛንቶሞናስ ውስጥ ካሉ ጂ.አ.ወ ጋር የሚመሳሰሉ ጄኔቲካዊ ለውጥ ቅጦችን ከዛሬ በፊት ያስተዋሉ ሲሆን የበለጠ ለመመርመር ወስነው ነበር።

English: They specifically wanted to study more about the relationship between this Nigerian strain and other strains found elsewhere.
Luganda: Okusingira ddala baayagala okwongera okunoonyereza ku nkolagana wakati w’ekika ky’e Nigeria kino n’ebika ebirala ebisangibwa awalala.
Yoruba: Wọ́n fẹ́ kọjú mọ́ wíwádìí síwájú sí i nípa ìbáṣepọ̀ tí ó wà láàrin irúfẹ̀ ti Nàìjíríà àti àwọn èyih tí wọ́n rí ilẹ̀ ibòmìíràn.
Zulu: Babefuna ikakhulukazi ukufunda kabanzi mayelana nobudlelwano phakathi kwalolu hlobo lwaseNigeria nezinye izinhlobo ezitholakala kwenye indawo.
Hausa: Suna son yin nazari na musamman game da dangantakar da take a tsakanin wannan nau’in Nijeriya da sauran nau’o’in da aka samu a wasu wurare.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba tloga ba nyaka go nyakišiši tše ntši ka ga kamano magareng ga diphetetšo tše tša ka Nigeria le diphetetšo tše dingwe tše di hwetšwago go gongwe.
Amharic: በተለይም በናይጄሪያ ስትሬን እና በሌላ ቦታዎች ባሉ ስትሬኖች መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት ማጥናት ፈልገው ነበር።

English: Through genetic analyses they indeed confirmed that this strain from Nigeria contains a GTA.
Luganda: Nga bayita mu kwekenneenya endagabutonde baakikakasa nti ekika kino eky’e Nigeria kyalina GTA.
Yoruba: Nípasẹ̀ ìtúpalẹ̀ ajẹmọ́jíìnì ni wọ́n fi fìdí ẹ̀ múlè pé ipa ti Nàìjíríà ní GTA kan.
Zulu: Ngokuhlaziywa kofuzo baqinisekise ngempela ukuthi lolu hlobo oluvela eNigeria luqukethe i-GTA.
Hausa: Ta hanyar nazarin ƙwayoyin gado sun tabbatar da cewa wannan nau’in daga Nijeriya yana ɗauke da GTA.
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomiša tshekatsheko ya ditšini ka nnete go ile gwa tiišetša gore phetišo ye ya go tšwa ka Nigeria e na le GTA.
Amharic: በጄኔቲክ ትንተናቸው በእርግጥም ከናይጄሪያ የመጣው ስትሬን ጂ.አ.ወ እንደሚይዝ አረጋግጠዋል።

English: They also found GTA clusters in other Xanthomonas, as well as species of Agrobacterium and Pantoea.
Luganda: Era baazuula ebirimba bya GTA mu Xanthomonas endala, awamu n’ebika bya Agrobacterium ne Pantoea.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún rí àwọn ìṣùpọ̀ GTA nínú àwọn ọ̀wọ́ batéríà mìíràn, àti lára àwọn ẹ̀yà batéríà aṣàtakò-yíyọ-irúgbìn àti àwọn batéríà apa-irúgbìn.
Zulu: Baphinde bathola amaqoqo e-GTA kwamanye ama-Xanthomonas, kanye nezinhlobo ze-Agrobacterium ne-Pantoea.
Hausa: Sun kuma sami gungu na GTA a cikin wasu Xanthomonas, da kuma jinsunan Agrobacterium da kuma Pantoea.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba hwetša gape dihlopha tša GTA ka go Xanthomonas tše dingwe, gammogo le mehuta ya Agrobacterium le Pantoea.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በሌሎች ዛንቶሞናስ ውስጥ እንዲሁም በአግሮባክቴሪየም እና በፓንቶኢያ ዝርያዎች ውስጥ ጂ.አ.ወ ስብስቦችን አግኝተዋል።

English: However, many of the other common plant disease-causing bacteria they investigated did not contain GTAs.
Luganda: Wabula, bakitiiriya nnyingi endala ezitera okulwaza ebimera ze baanoonyerezaako tezaalimu GTAs.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ ṣá, ọ̀pọ̀ àwọn irúgbìn tí ó lè fa kòkòrò batéríà yòókù tí wọ́n ṣe ìtọpinpin wọn kò ni àwọn GTA.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, amagciwane amaningi avamile abangela izifo zezitshalo abawaphenyayo ayengenawo ama-GTA.
Hausa: Ko ta yaya, yawancin sauran ƙwayoyin cuta masu haifar da cututtukan tsirrai waɗanda suka bincika ba su ƙunshi GTAs ba.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjale, bontši bja diphedi tše dingwe tše di tlwaelegilego tše di bakago malwetši go dimela tše ba di nyakišišitšego di be di se na le di-GTA.
Amharic: ነገርግን ሌሎቹ በጣም የተለመዱት የአትክልት በሽታ አምጪ ባክቴሪያዎች ጂ.አ.ወን እንደማይዙ አጣርተው ነበር።

English: The researchers said bacteria with GTAs were more likely to change their genetic makeup over time than those without.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti bakitiiriya ezirina GTAs zaali zisuubirwa nnyo okukyusa obukole bw’endagabutonde zaazo oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera okusinga ku ezo ezitalina.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé ó ṣeé ṣe kí kòkòrò batéríà tí ó ní àwọn GTA pa jíìnì wọn dà bí ó bá ti ń pẹ́ ju àwọn tí kò ní lọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi amagciwane anama-GTA maningi amathuba okuthi ashintshe ukwakheka kwawo kofuzo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi kunalawo angenawo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce ƙwayoyin cutar da suke ɗauke da GTA sun fi sauya yanayin halittarsu yau da gobe fiye da waɗanda ba su da su.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dipakthewria tša go ba le di-GTA go be go na le kgonagalo ye kgolo ya gore di ka fetoša sebopego sa ditšini tša tšona ge nako e dutše e sepela go feta tšeo di e hlokago.
Amharic: ተመራማሪቹ ጂ.አ.ወ የሚይዙ ባክቴሬያዎች ከሌሉቹ ጋር ሲነጻጸሩ በጊዜ ብዛት ጄኔቲካዊ አሰራራቸውን የመቀየር አዝማሚያቸው ከፍተኛ ነው ብለዋል።

English: They cannot say why only certain bacteria have GTAs, but suspect it may help those that have it to infect their host.
Luganda: Tebasobola kulaga lwaki bakitiiriya ezimu zirina GTAs, naye basuubira nti eyinza okuyamba ezo ezigirina okulwaza ekyo kye ziyingiramu.
Yoruba: Wọ́n kò lè sọ ìdí tí ó fi jẹ́ pé àwọn kòkòrò batéríà kọ̀ọ̀kan ni wọ́n ní àwọn GTA, àmọ́ wọ́n fura pé ó lè ṣe ìr̀nwọ́ fún àwọn tí wọ́n ní láti ṣe ìkóràn fún àwọn olùgbalejò wọn.
Zulu: Abakwazi ukusho ukuthi kungani kuphela amagciwane athile anama-GTA, kodwa asola ukuthi angasiza labo abanawo ukuthi bathelele abawaphethe.
Hausa: Ba za su iya cewa ga dalilin da ya sa kawai wasu ƙwayoyin cuta ksue da GTAs ba, amma suna zargin yana iya taimakawa waɗanda suke da su cutar da mai mazauninsu.
Northern Sotho: Ga ba kgone go tseba gore ke ka lebaka la eng e le dipaktheria tše itšego di na le di-GTA, eupša ba belaela gore se se ka thuša tšeo di nago le tšona go fetetša semela seo di lego go sona.
Amharic: ለምን አንዳንድ ባክቴሪያዎች ብቻ ጂ.አ.ወ እንዳላቸው መናገር አይችሉም፤ ነገር ግን ላላቸው ባክቴሪያዎች ተሸካሚያቸውን ኢንፌክት ለማድረግ ሊረዳቸው ይችላል።

English: They also speculate that perhaps these bacteria only recently gained GTA elements.
Luganda: Era bateebereza nti oboolyawo bakitiiriya zino zaakafuna GTA.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe àhesọ pé bóyá àwọn batéríà wọ̀nyí ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ gba àwọn GTA ni.
Zulu: Baphinde bacabange ukuthi mhlawumbe la magciwane asanda kuthola izakhi ze-GTA.
Hausa: Haka nan sun kuma yi hasashen cewa wataƙila waɗannan ƙwayoyin cuta kwanan nan sun sami abubuwan GTA.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba akanya gape gore mohlomongwe dipaktheria tše di sa tšwa go hwetša dikarolo tša GTA mo nakong ye e sa tšwago go feta.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ እነዚህ ባክቴሪያዎች የጂ.አ.ወ ንጥረ ነገሮቻቸውን ያገኙት በቅርብ ጊዜ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ይገምታሉ።

English: Xanthomonas causes bacterial spots on leaves and fruit, leading to crop losses.
Luganda: Xanthomonas ereeta obuba bwa bakitiiriya ku bikoola n’ekibala, ekiviirako okufiirwa ekimera.
Yoruba: Àwọn ọ̀wọ́ batéríà a máa fa ipa batéríà sára àwọn ewé àti èso, èyí tí ó máa ń jásí ìpàdánù èso.
Zulu: I-Xanthomonas idala amachashaza ebhaktheriya emaqabunga nasesithelweni, okuholela ekulahlekeni kwezitshalo.
Hausa: Xanthomonas yana haifar da tabo na ƙwayoyin cuta a kan ganye da ‘ya’yan itace, wanda yake haifar da asarar amfanin gona.
Northern Sotho: Xanthomonas e baka dipatso tša dipaktheria go matlakala a dimela le go dikenywa, gomme se sa feletša ka tahlegelo ya dibjalo.
Amharic: ዛንቶሞናስ በቅጠሎች እና በፍራፍሬዎች ላይ የባክቴሪያ ነጥቦችን ሊያስከስቱ ይችላሉ፣ ይህም ለሰብል ውድመት ይዳርጋል።

English: Understanding how this strain from Nigeria evolves and infects plants with the help of GTAs could help researchers understand how to manage this and other plant diseases in future.
Luganda: Okutegeera engeri ekika kino okuva mu Nigeria gye kikyukakyukamu n’okukwata ebimera nga kiyambibwako GTAs kiyinza okuyamba abanoonyereza okutegeera engeri y’okukwatamu endwadde y’ebimera eno n’endala gye bujja.
Yoruba: Níní òye bí àwòmọ́ ti ilẹ̀ Nàìjíríà se ń jẹyọ tí ó sì ń ṣe ìkóràn àìsàn fún àwọn irúgbìn pẹ̀lú ìrànwọ́ àwọn GTA lè ran àwọn aṣèwádìí lọ́wọ́ láti ní òye bí wọ́n se lè ṣàkóso èyí àti àwọn àìsàn irúgbìn mìíràn lọ́jọ́ iwájú.
Zulu: Ukuqonda ukuthi lolu hlobo oluvela eNigeria lushintsha kanjani futhi luthelele izitshalo ngosizo lwama-GTA kungasiza abacwaningi baqonde ukuthi bangaphatha kanjani lesi sifo nezinye izifo zezitshalo esikhathini esizayo.
Hausa: Fahimtar yadda wannan nau’i daga Nijeriya yake tasowa da kuma cutar da tsirrai tare da taimakon GTAs zai iya taimakawa masu bincike su fahimci yadda za a magance wannan da ma sauran cututtuka na tsirrai a nan gaba.
Northern Sotho: Go kwešiša ka fao phetetšo ye ya ka Nigeria e diregago ka gona le go fetetša dimela ka thušo ya di-GTA go ka thuša banyakišiši go kwešiša ka fao ba ka laolago se le malwetši a mangwe a dimela ka moso.
Amharic: በጂ.አ.ወ እርዳታ ይሄ ከናይጄሪያ የመጣ ስትሬን ዝግመታዊ እድገት እንዳለው እና አትክልቶችን ኢንፌክት እንዴት እንደሚያደርግ መረዳት ተመራማሪዎች ይህንን እና ወደፊት የሚከሰቱ የአትክልት በሽታዎችን እንዴተ ማስተዳደር እንዳለባቸው እንዲገነዘቡ ሊያግዛቸው ይችላል።
